planned_experiments: Python SDK concurrent reader versus erase

implementation.tdd_requirement: Each future narrow experiment must have a committed or visibly staged RED predicate before its GREEN instrumentation/coordination implementation. The retained-result RED proves missing or misclassified required collector evidence; it does not expect a materialized result to cause BUSY.

fix_n.review_finding: Projection dispatcher and worker SQLite connections were omitted from the owned-role model, and the retained-result RED wording encoded a false BUSY expectation.
fix_n.resolution: All Engine-owned roles carry indexed transaction/snapshot transitions; no-owned classification requires every reader and runtime role idle plus no local checkpoint overlap. The retained-result control expects zero owned transaction/snapshot with successful erasure, and RED is absence/misclassification of that diagnostic fact.
